A '''turbolaser pulsor''' was a type of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] mounted on the [[MAS-2xB]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] platform.

==Characteristics==
The turbolaser pulsor used an amplification dish around the [[turbolaser actuator]] to focus its energy beam, which had a maximum range of thirty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], and an optimal range of ten kilometers. The beam was capable of penetrating [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] thick, and its energy output was equivalent to that of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]]. The power demands meant that the weapon could only fire once a [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]], and required four rows of [[cooling chamber]]s with meter-long [[cryogenic cylinder]]s wrapping around the [[Power core/Legends|power core]], [[energy capacitor]]s, and pulsor itself to keep the system cooled and prevent meltdowns during combat.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
